title: VIVE Focus Vision + Wired Streaming Kit + Facial Tracker
body_html:
A 5K hybrid VR headset that works standalone or with PCVR, featuring built-in eye tracking, a hot-swappable battery, and full-body tracking support—completely base station-free. For the highest fidelity, connect in DisplayPort Mode. The VIVE Focus Vision Wired Bundle includes the headset, cable, and converter for a visually lossless connection.

Visit VIVE Focus Vision overview ›

Visit Facial Tracker overview ›

VIVE Wired Streaming Kit enables DisplayPort mode for visually lossless, high-fidelity PC-VR streaming.

FAQ Content
What is the VIVE Focus Vision and who is it for?
VIVE Focus Vision is a hybrid VR headset that works both as a standalone all-in-one XR device and as a PC VR headset. It’s made for gamers, content creators, and VRChat users who want high-quality visuals, low-latency wireless gameplay, and support for tracking accessories like full-body and face trackers.
Is VIVE Focus Vision a standalone headset or does it require a PC?
It works as both a standalone headset and a PC-connected headset (wired or wireless). Users can switch between mobile convenience and high-performance PC VR.
Which full-body trackers are compatible with VIVE Focus Vision?
It supports VIVE Ultimate Trackers with inside-out tracking. No base stations are required. (Functionality depends on content compatibility.)
Can I use VIVE Focus Vision for VRChat full-body avatars?
Yes. Connect to a VR-ready PC running SteamVR and use VIVE Ultimate Trackers wirelessly via the VIVE Wireless Dongle. Ensure the app supports full-body tracking.
Can I use VIVE Focus Vision without external base stations?
Yes. Inside-out tracking eliminates the need for base stations.
Do I need the Wired Streaming Kit to use VIVE Focus Vision?
No. Wireless streaming via VIVE Hub is supported. However, the Wired Streaming Kit is required for DisplayPort streaming and gives the best performance, especially for demanding titles or poor Wi-Fi conditions.
Is the VIVE Focus Vision comfortable?
Yes. It features balanced weight distribution, cooling fans, washable face padding, and an adjustable fit for long sessions.
Does VIVE Focus Vision have built-in face tracking?
Not built in, but it supports the Facial Tracker for VIVE Focus Series, sold separately.
Is eye tracking built into VIVE Focus Vision?
Yes. It includes integrated eye tracking and automatic IPD adjustment, improving visual clarity and interaction.
What is eye tracking used for in VR apps and games?
Eye tracking enhances avatar expression and enables intuitive UI navigation via gaze.
What is the display resolution and field of view of the VIVE Focus Vision?
2448 × 2448 pixels per eye (4896 × 2448 total) with a maximum 120° field of view.
Can I play SteamVR games with VIVE Focus Vision?
Yes. When connected to a VR-ready PC, you can play SteamVR titles through VIVE Hub (wireless) or the Wired Streaming Kit (USB + DisplayPort).
How do I connect VIVE Focus Vision to my PC for VR gaming?
Either wirelessly through VIVE Hub (Wi-Fi 6 recommended) or via the Wired Streaming Kit for low-latency DisplayPort streaming.
What apps and games can I use with VIVE Focus Vision out of the box?
Standalone users access VIVEPORT apps and games. With a PC connection, users can access SteamVR titles like Half-Life: Alyx, Blade & Sorcery, Beat Saber, and VRChat.
What is the battery life on VIVE Focus Vision?
Up to 2 hours of active use. The battery is hot-swappable, with 15–20 minutes of reserve power during swaps. Fast charging reaches 50% in ~30 minutes with the included 30W adapter. DisplayPort streaming can help sustain battery level during long PC VR sessions.
Does VIVE Focus Vision have a standard warranty?
Yes. It includes a limited one-year consumer warranty covering manufacturing defects and hardware faults. Accessories and batteries may have separate terms.

 

Helpful information

1. PC VR content is accessible via VIVE Streaming within VIVE Hub on PC. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. Latency and visual quality of VR/MR content are dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection. Verify your PC meets the requirements for Streaming. Connect your computer directly to your Wi-Fi router using an Ethernet cable for PC VR streaming. To connect to a PC via DisplayPort, VIVE Focus Vision also requires VIVE Wired Streaming Cable (DisplayPort mode compatible) and VIVE Wired Streaming Converter (DisplayPort mode compatible), both of which are included in VIVE Wired Streaming Kit (DisplayPort mode compatible). 2. Content compatibility required. Please check the specifications to ensure the content supports eye tracking and related functions like foveated rendering. Performance may vary by title or application and may be affected by eye surgery, eye disease, heavy makeup, and/or high myopia. 3. Hand tracking features are VR title dependent. Check the VR title's description for compatible inputs or use a filtered search for hand tracking-enabled content. 4. The precision of the auto-IPD adjustment may vary from user to user. 5. Depth-sensing-enabled features are limited to indoor environments. Available virtual interactions using scene understanding are dependent on content compatibility. 6. The front internal battery is only intended to sustain power long enough for the rear battery to be swapped with a freshly charged VIVE Battery for Focus Series, and for no more than 20 minutes at a time. Please see the user guide for instructions on swapping the rear battery correctly. 7. VIVE Desk is accessible within VIVE Hub on PC. System requirements must be met. PC required. Visual quality of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection. 8. VIVE Ultimate Trackers sold separately. Content compatibility required. 9. MicroSD card not included. 10. Wi-Fi 6E support is country dependent. For more details visit manufacturer's support site. 11. 120 Hz PC VR support via DisplayPort mode [Beta]. 12. Glasses must be able to fit within the 150 mm wide facial interface, and the gasket spacer included in the box may need to be attached to the headset to provide sufficient depth. In some cases, the wide version of the gasket spacer may be needed. Availability varies by region. 13. All battery claim results will vary. Battery life and charge cycles vary by use. 14. VIVE Wired Streaming Kit supports VIVE Focus Vision headset. System requirements must be met. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. Visual quality and low latency of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection.

The Facial Tracker is an accessory that adds real-time facial expression tracking to supported VIVE headsets. It captures movements like lips, jaw, cheeks, and tongue to bring more lifelike expressions to avatars, VRChat interactions, and VTuber content.

It works with VIVE Focus Vision and VIVE Focus 3 headsets.

The tracker uses a mono camera to read facial movements using 38 blend shapes across areas like lips, jaw, cheeks, chin, teeth, and tongue at a 60 Hz tracking rate for smooth, low-latency performance.

It connects directly via the headset’s built-in USB-Type-C port—no extra adapters or cables required.

You need content that supports face tracking (e.g., VRChat avatars with face tracking support). Compatible software must also meet system requirements.

Yes, when streaming PC VR or using apps that support facial tracking via OpenXR extensions or compatible SDKs, you can use the tracker in supported PC VR titles.

SDK support is provided for Unity, Unreal Engine, and native development. Developers can integrate facial tracking into their apps using available SDKs and runtimes.

You can enable facial tracking for VRChat avatars that support the VRCFaceTracking protocol. In PC VR setups, you’ll often need to configure VIVE Hub and VRChat’s OSC/VRCFT settings to route the tracker data.

Yes, facial tracking enhances non-verbal communication, avatar performance capture, soft skills training, VR collaboration, and creative applications.

VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition – FAQs


Is VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition enterprise-ready?
Yes. It includes centralized device management, enterprise support, and business-grade security for large-scale deployments.

Is VIVE Focus Vision a standalone VR headset?
Yes. It operates fully standalone with no PC or external hardware required. It also supports PC-VR streaming.*

Does VIVE Focus Vision support eye tracking?
Yes. Built-in eye tracking enables training analytics, research insights, and performance optimization through foveated rendering.*

What are the primary use cases for VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition?
Location-Based Entertainment (LBE) for arcades and entertainment centers, Government & Public Safety use cases including training, simulation, and mission-critical visualization, and other applications that require a robust, multiuser VR experience.

Is this headset suitable for government and public safety organizations?
Yes. It is designed for government, defense, and public safety deployments requiring secure, managed XR hardware.

Is VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition TAA compliant?
Yes. All VIVE headsets are manufactured in a TAA-designated region and meet the requirements set forth by Section 889 of the NDAA in the United States.

How does the Business Edition differ from consumer VR headsets?
VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition is built for commercial use, offering enterprise device management, business-grade support, and VIVE Business Warranty & Services (BWS), which is available to, and required for, customers using VIVE Focus Vision for commercial purposes.

How does this differ from Meta Quest 3 and 3S headsets?
VIVE Focus Vision features built-in eye tracking, a durable alloy chassis, a hot-swappable battery, easy-to-clean magnetic gaskets, and an active cooling system designed to minimize headset downtime in high-traffic environments.

Who is this headset designed for?
Enterprises, government & public safety organizations, and location-based experience operators using VR for training and simulation, manufacturing workflows, remote collaboration, and immersive design and visualization.

Is it compatible with enterprise XR applications and workflows?
Yes. It supports leading enterprise XR applications and professional deployment workflows.
